Commentary.Commentary: Zimbabwe's head coach, Heath Streak will be happy with his bowlers as they hardly put a foot wrong on the field today. They kept troubling the visitors by sticking to their plans. Graeme Cremer was the pick of the bowlers as he ended with figures of 10-0-46-3. Tendai Chatara and Chris Mpofu also picked up a couple of wickets each to maintain the pressure. However, it should be an exciting chase as the hosts come out to hunt the total down. Join us in a while for the Zimbabwe innings.

A decent batting performance by Afghanistan after electing to bat first. After losing Mohammad Shahzad early, Noor Ali Zadran and Rahmat Shah calmed things up and stitched together a 67-run stand. However, they failed to build on it. The away team skipper Asghar Stanikzai scored some quick runs, smashing his 7th ODI fifty in the process, but kept losing partners at the other end. The lower middle order failed to capitalize as they slipped from 156-3 to 169-7. Just when the 200-run mark was looking distant, it was Rashid Khan who came to the fore and scored a breezy knock of 32 runs in 18 balls to end Afghanistan's innings on 215.
OUT c Sikandar Raza b Tendai Chatara. Afghanistan have been bowled out.
OUT c Peter Moor b Tendai Chatara. Afghanistan have lost their ninth wicket.
OUT c Ryan Burl b Chris Mpofu. Afghanistan have lost their eighth wicket.

After 45 overs, Afghanistan are 181/7. Zimbabwe have made a comeback by picking up wickets in quick succession. This has helped them to keep the score in check. In the pursuit of big runs, the Afghanistani batsmen have lost their way. With only 3 wickets in hand, can the visitors go past the 200-run mark or will the hosts curtail them below it?
OUT c & b Graeme Cremer. Afghanistan have lost their seventh wicket.
OUT c Solomon Mire b Chris Mpofu. Afghanistan have lost their sixth wicket.

After 40 overs, Afghanistan have been stalled at 158/5 by Zimbabwe. Just when it seemed that the tourists have gained some control going into the last 10 overs, both Hashmatullah Shahidi and Asghar Stanikzai were forced to take the long walk back to the pavilion. Raza has been the standout bowler conceding only 32 runs in his 9 overs so far. He also dismissed the visiting captain moments after the latter got to his fifty.
OUT c Tarisai Musakanda b Sikandar Raza. Afghanistan have lost their fifth wicket.
OUT Hashmatullah Shahidi run out (Chris Mpofu). Afghanistan have lost their fourth wicket.

After 35 overs, Afghanistan are scoring slowly and have amassed 132 runs for the loss of three wickets. Crucially for the visiting side, no wickets have fallen in the last 5 overs. Stanikzai is looking dangerous and is ticking the scoreboard without taking any risks.

After 30 overs, Afghanistan have crossed the 100-run mark and reached 112/3. They lost two set batsmen at a crucial time and it was necessary for the middle order to reconstruct their innings. That's what the visiting team skipper Asghar Stanikzai has managed to do with Hashmatullah Shahidi, who has assisted him well from the other end. They have scored only 15 runs in the last 5 overs but they won't mind that and will look to accelerate in the coming overs.

We are halfway through the first innings and after 25 overs, AFGHANISTAN HAVE REACHED 97/3. The last 5 overs have yielded 2 wickets for the home side with both set batsmen, Rahmat and Noor Ali Zadran dismissed by skipper Cremer. They will now be hoping to get more inroads into this strong batting line-up of the visitors. The Afghans, on the other hand, need to start afresh for this second half of their innings and skipper Stanikzai will try and ensure that a collapse does not ensue.
OUT lbw b Graeme Cremer. Afghanistan have lost their third wicket.
OUT c Tarisai Musakanda b Graeme Cremer. Afghanistan have lost their second wicket.

After 20 overs, Afghanistan have reached the score of 75/1. The recovery continues for the visiting side, with Noor Ali Zadran and Rahmat Shah faring well after seeing off the new balls. Zimbabwe are struggling to contain the stroke-makers and if they don't get a wicket quickly, this might start going away from them.

After 15 overs, Afghanistan have recovered well to reach 52/1. After the initial stutter, the tourists have began to score more freely, with the run rate rising. They have looked to attack all the bad deliveries. Both Rahmat Shah and Noor Ali Zadran are looking in good nick and it is vital for Zimbabwe to break this partnership as soon as possible.

After 10 overs, Afghanistan are 28/1. Noor Ali Zadran and Rahmat Shah have managed to steady the ship after losing Shahzad early. However, the Zimbabwean bowlers have kept the scoreboard in check. Tendai Chatara has bowled a superb spell to play the perfect foil to debutant Richard Ngarava.

After 5 overs, Afghanistan are 13/1. A poor start for the visitors where they have lost their mainstay, Mohammad Shahzad. He fell prey to the debutant Richard Ngarava. Zimbabwe bowlers have put brakes on the scoring. Zadran and Rahmat Shah have rebuilding to do as they look to give the away side a good start.
OUT c Chris Mpofu b Richard Ngarava. Afghanistan have lost their first wicket.

The players are out in the middle. Mohammad Shahzad and Noor Ali Zadran will open with the bat for Afghanistan while Tendai Chatara will begin the proceedings with the ball for Zimbabwe. Unfortunately, due to lack of television feed, there won't be ball-by-ball commentary for this match but we shall keep you posted with updates.
Toss - Afghanistan win the toss and opt to bat first. Ryan Burl and Richard Ngarava make their ODI debuts for Zimbabwe.

The visitors on the other hand are high on confidence after a successful Desert T20 competition in which they were unbeaten throughout. The away side have also never lost a series in Zimbabwe so there is plenty of things at stake in this series. Join us in a while for the toss.

Hello and a warm welcome for the first ODI between Zimbabwe and Afghanistan at Harare Sports Club. The hosts have taken a brave move by leaving out a number of seasoned campaigners. They still do boast of having a really good bowling unit under their very own legend Heath Streak.
